name: Root Layer + Empty Layer Creation
objective: Seed a Root GroupLayer in new projects, expose child-layer creation in LayerPanel, add a hit-testable backing plane to ShaderLayerGroup, and verify Viewport invalidation.
exit_criteria: New project via newProject() produces a layers array with exactly one GroupLayer named 'Root' at position {0,0} and size {1920,1080}
ProjectStore exposes createEmptyLayer(name, parentId?) that creates and adds a GroupLayer
LayerPanel toolbar 'Add Group' button is renamed to 'Add Layer' and calls createEmptyLayer, inserting inside selected GroupLayer or at root
LayerTreeItem shows a '+' icon button on hover for group rows that creates a child layer inside that group
ShaderLayerGroup renders a transparent backing mesh (opacity 0, depthWrite false) that is hit-testable and selects the layer on click
ShaderLayerGroup shows PanHandle and ResizeHandle when the layer is selected, wired to projectStore.updateLayer()
Viewport Scene is observer() — confirmed no additional invalidate wiring is needed (or the minimal fix is applied)
